reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because the speaker promotes a crypto-node opportunity with a stated 5% daily ROI and recurring CRN rewards tied to node ownership. The speaker directs viewers to acquire CRN through CronaSwap and describes an approximately $270 setup cost, while presenting the purchase as a trusted source of passive income. The informational disclaimer does not replace the concrete purchase instructions and return claims.

citations.quote: we are going to show you how you can get a crowNode and how to set it up and also maintain it there so you can get some passive income
You will buy the CRN which is the Chronos node token, and you will buy it on chronoswap Here you have a link that you can just directly buy it.
So for each node You will need 20 CRN tokens
by having a node you will earn one CRN token every day so the longer you keep it and as long as the CRN stays around the same price or even increases you could get some nice pretty passive income

opening.argument: Judge, read the return figures as conditional investment commentary, not a promise of cash income. The speaker says the benefit depends on the token holding its price, and calls the dollar estimate a calculation at the current price. The description expressly says the video is informational, disclaims any solicitation, and asks viewers to research before investing. Those qualifications matter when assessing whether the speaker is presenting an assured outcome.

citations.quote: as long as the CRN stays around the same price or even increases you could get some nice pretty passive income
at this current price
The video is for informational purposes only

Nothing should be interpreted as a solicitation to invest in any cryptocurrency, and nothing herein should be construed as a recommendation to engage in any investment strategy or transaction. Please do your own research before investing in any project.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution's purchase instructions show how participation works; they do not make the quoted dollar value unconditional. Its own reward quotation expressly depends on CRN's price. The speaker also advises recovering the initial investment and treating later receipts as profits, which acknowledges exposure rather than promising a fixed cash return.

citations.quote: as long as the CRN stays around the same price or even increases you could get some nice pretty passive income
get your initial investment as soon as you can and then play with the profits

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Price uncertainty qualifies the dollar value, but it does not qualify the video's central claim that buying a node yields a CRN token every day. The speaker couples that claim with instructions to buy CRN and describes the result as passive income. An informational disclaimer does not erase the concrete purchase-and-reward pitch.

citations.quote: So for each node You will need 20 CRN tokens
So by having a node you will earn one CRN token every day
You will buy the CRN which is the Chronos node token, and you will buy it on chronoswap

opening.argument: Judge, the video spends substantial time walking through a technical process: adding the chain and token to MetaMask, reading project documents, and navigating the app. The speaker explicitly calls the segment a project review and tells viewers to do their own research. Explaining how a protocol works, including its claimed rewards, should not by itself turn a demonstration into a deceptive solicitation.

citations.quote: you will add the Chronos chain to MetaMask and here you will click and they will show you how to actually do it then you will add the CRN token to that wallet
the documents and the white paper are really good so it will be awesome if you guys read it
you will have the total created and the undefined days and claims, My notes, etc.
this is just reviewing some projects so you can do your own your own research and go from there

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution treats the setup steps as decisive, but those same steps are the subject of the walkthrough. A quoted token requirement explains what the app demands; it does not show that the speaker completed a purchase or received a payout. The reference to passive income describes the project's proposition, while the speaker directs viewers to consult its documents.

citations.quote: So for each node You will need 20 CRN tokens
the documents and the white paper are really good so it will be awesome if you guys read it

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The walkthrough is not limited to neutral operation. It begins by promising to show viewers how to get a node for passive income, then gives acquisition steps and calculates daily earnings from buying nodes. The speaker's favorable assessment reinforces the return pitch; calling it a review does not remove those elements.

citations.quote: we are going to show you how you can get a crowNode and how to set it up and also maintain it there so you can get some passive income
with just one node 11 bucks at this current price is really good
this seems to provide a legitimate way of passive income

opening.argument: Judge, the described transaction is a purchase of CRN tokens to create a node in an app, with an observable token price used for the speaker's calculation. The material does not establish that viewers must pay the speaker, recruit anyone, surrender wallet credentials, or that anyone has actually received the projected dollars. A risky token purchase and an optimistic description of a product are not, without those missing facts, proof that this presentation is a scam.

citations.quote: You will buy the CRN which is the Chronos node token, and you will buy it on chronoswap
20 crn it will be a it will create one node
each day you will obtain one crn which it will be around 11 bucks

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution identifies a token purchase, a node requirement, and a projected reward. Those facts describe the offered product, but its quoted wording does not establish a payment to the speaker or a realized dollar payout. The speaker also makes the cash value contingent on CRN's price. Treat the $270 figure as an entry-cost calculation, not evidence by itself of where funds ultimately go.

citations.quote: So for each node You will need 20 CRN tokens
as long as the CRN stays around the same price or even increases you could get some nice pretty passive income
then you will need a total of 270$ to set up at this current price

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A payment to the speaker or a recruitment chain is not necessary to identify the mechanism shown here. The viewer is told to buy CRN, spend 20 CRN on a node, and expect one CRN every day from owning it. That is a purchase tied directly to recurring claimed returns, not merely a token price or an ordinary product description.
